mapper.select: select c3.C_Name as bdRecommendUnitName, c4.C_Name as bdExcellentTeamUnitName, c3.C_Abbreviation as bdRecomAbbName, c4.C_Abbreviation as bdExcellTeamAbbName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Name as secName, bd.* from Sec_Determin_Doc bd left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=bd.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on bd.Bd_Recommend_Unit=c3.C_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on bd.Bd_Excellent_Team_Unit=c4.C_Id where bd.Bd_Id=#{bdId}
